pricing.title:
💰 **Pricing Information:**

Our machines are competitively priced based on:
• **Machine type & capacity**
• **Customization level**
• **Additional features**
• **Installation & training**

**Price Ranges:**
• Small-scale: $15,000 - $50,000
• Medium-scale: $50,000 - $150,000
• Large-scale: $150,000 - $500,000+

For an **exact quote**, please:
1. Visit our **Order** page
2. Call us: +971 4 123 4567
3. Click WhatsApp below

custom.title:
🔧 **Custom Machinery Solutions:**

Yes! We specialize in custom-designed machinery for your unique requirements.

**Customization Options:**
• Capacity adjustments (±30%)
• Material specifications (SS304, SS316, HARDOX)
• Automation level (Manual to fully automated)
• Space constraints
• Special processing requirements

**Process:**
1. **Consultation** - Understand your needs
2. **Design** - CAD drawings & 3D models
3. **Approval** - You review & approve
4. **Manufacturing** - Precision fabrication
5. **Delivery** - Installation & training

Ready to discuss your custom project? Click **Order** or **WhatsApp** me! 🎯

capacity.title:
📊 **Capacity Information:**

Our machines are available in various capacities:

**Poultry Feeders:** 5-50 tons/hour
**Hammer Mills:** 10-100 tons/hour
**Mixers:** 1-20 tons/batch
**Pellet Mills:** 5-50 tons/hour
**Complete Plants:** 1-100 tons/hour

**Factors affecting capacity:**
• Raw material type & moisture
• Screen size (for grinding)
• Die specifications (for pelleting)
• Operational efficiency

What capacity do you need? I can recommend the best machine for your production goals! 🎯
